question: A computer is marked at ₹70,000 and a discount of 16% is offered on it. An additional discount is offered to students. If a student pays ₹57,036 for the computer, then how much additional discount percentage did the student receive?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Price of the computer after the first discount = 84% of ₹70,000 = ₹58,800

Additional discount offered to the student = ₹58,800 − ₹57,036 = ₹1,764

Additional discount % = (1764 ÷ 58800) × 100 = 3%

**∴ The correct answer is 3%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹70,000

First Discount (d₁) = 16%

Final Selling Price (SP) = ₹57,036

 
 ₹70,000
